spans.s: रुक रुक, अस्, आ, अम्, liberal, bountiful.
रुक्काम रुक्-काम. See under 2. रुच्, p. 848.

रुक्प्रतिक्रिया रुक्-प्रतिक्रिया. See under
2. रुज्, p. 848, col. 3.

रुक्म, अस्, आ, अम्, bright, radiant, clear; (अस्),
m. an ornament of gold, golden chain, (perhaps
also) an ornament of precious stones (Ved.); the
[]
plant Mesua Roxburghii; the thorn-apple; N. of a
son of Rucaka; (अम्), n. gold; iron.
—रुक्म-
कवच, अस्, m., N. of a grandson of Uśanas.
—रुक्म-कारक, अस्, m. a worker in gold, gold-
smith.
—रुक्म-केश, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Bhīṣmaka.
—रुक्म-पाश, अस्, m., Ved. a string
on which golden ornaments are worn.
—रुक्म-पुर,
अम्, n. ‘city of gold,’ N. of the city inhabited by
Garuḍa.
—रुक्म-पृष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
gold surface, coated or overlaid with gold, gold-
plated, gilded.
—रुक्म-प्रस्तरण, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. having an outer garment decorated with gold.
—रुक्म-बाहु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Bhīṣmaka.
—रुक्म-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of gold, golden.
—रुक्म-मालिन्, ई, m., N. of a son of Bhīṣmaka.
—रुक्म-रथ, अस्, m. a golden car or chariot; the
chariot of Rukma-ratha, i. e. of Droṇa; (अस्, आ, अम्),
having a golden chariot; (अस्), m., N. of Droṇa; of
a son of Śalya; of a son of Mahat; of a son of
Bhīṣmaka.
—रुक्म-वक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved.
golden-breasted, having golden ornaments on the
breast (said of the Maruts).
—रुक्म-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, possessing gold, golden, ornamented with gold;
(आन्), m. a proper N., = रुक्मिन्; (अती), f. a parti-
cular metre, four times ¯˘˘¯¯¯˘˘¯¯; N. of
a granddaughter of Rukmin and wife of Aniruddha.
—रुक्म-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, golden-carred, hav-
ing a golden chariot; (अस्), m., N. of Droṇa.
—रुक्म-स्तेय, अम्, n. stealing gold.
—रुक्माङ्-
गद (˚म-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, wearing a golden
bracelet on the upper arm; (अस्), m., N. of various
kings.
—रुक्माभ (˚म-आभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, shining
like gold, bright as the purest gold.
—रुक्मेषु
(˚म-इषु), उस्, m. ‘golden-arrowed,’ N. of a king.

रुक्मत् रुक्-मत्, रुङ्-मत्. See under 2. रुच्,
p. 848, col. 3.

रुक्ष 1. रुक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see p. 848,
col. 1), rough, harsh, &c. = रूक्ष, q. v.; [cf. Angl.
Sax. rug, ruh, ruw; Eng. rough, rugged.]

2. रुक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see p. 847, col. 3),
Ved. shining, brilliant, radiant, glittering, (Sāy. =
दीप्त.)

रूक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps fr. rt. 1. रुष्, q. v.,
but according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. 1. रुह्;
and according to others connected with rt. रूष् and
रूषित; sometimes written रुक्ष, see 1. रुक्ष),
rough, harsh (to the touch), not smooth or soft;
rough to the taste, astringent, not bland; rough,
rugged, uneven, difficult; harsh, cruel, unkind, un-
couth, austere; firm, dry, arid, parched, emaciated;
(अस्), m. a species of grass (= वरक); a tree [cf.
रुह्वन्, according to some for Prākṛt rukkha =
वृक्ष]; (आ), f. Croton Polyandrum or Croton
Tiglium.
—रूक्ष-गन्धक, अस्, m. bdellium.
—रूक्ष-ता, f. or रूक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. roughness,
harshness, dryness, aridity, emaciation; harshness,
unkindness, unfriendliness.
—रूक्ष-दर्भ, अस्,
m. a kind of grass.
—रूक्ष-पत्त्र, अस्, m. Tro-
phis Aspera (= शाखोट).
—रूक्ष-पेषम्, ind.,
with rt. पिष्, to pound dry, i. e. without adding
butter or any liquid (Pāṇ.

).
—रूक्ष-
प्रिय, अस्, m. = ऋषभौषध.
—रूक्ष-
स्वादु-फल, अस्, m. a species of fruit tree.
—रू-
क्षी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make rough or
dry.
—रूक्षी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made rough, soiled,
besmeared, covered with, (पांसु-रूक्षीकृत, soiled
or covered with dust; cf. रूषित.)

रुक्सद्मन् रुक्-सद्मन्, रुग्-अन्वित, &c.
See under 2. रुज्, p. 848, col. 3.

रुक्मि, इस्, m. a proper N. (= रुक्मिन्; in one
or two passages रुक्मिम् is used for रुक्मिणम् on
account of the metre).

रुक्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wearing golden ornaments,
decorated with golden ornaments (Ved.), gilded,
gilt; (ई), m., N. of the eldest son of Bhīṣmaka
and adversary of Kṛṣṇa (who carried off his sister
Rukmiṇī; he was slain by Bala-deva); N. of a
mountain; (इणी), f., N. of a daughter of Bhīṣmaka
carried off and espoused by Kṛṣṇa, (she is repre-
sented as the mother of Pra-dyumna, and in the
later mythology = ) the goddess Lakṣmī; N. of
Dākṣāyaṇī in Dvāravatī; of a daughter of Śreṣ-
thin Sulocana.
—रुक्मि-दर्प, अस्, m., N. of Bala-
deva (so called as proud of having overcome Rukmin).
—रुक्मि-दारिन्, ई, or रुक्मि-दारण, अस्, or
रुक्मि-भिद्, त्, m. ‘destroyer of Rukmin,’ N. of
Bala-deva.

रूक्ष् रूक्ष् (more properly regarded as
a Nom. fr. रूक्ष below; cf. rts. 1. रुष्,
रूष्, रूषित), cl. 10. P. रूक्षयति (according
to Vopa-deva also रूक्षापयति), -यितुम्, Aor.
अरुरूक्षत्, to be rough or harsh; to make dry or
emaciated (Ved.); to soil, smear (Ved.).

रूक्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, making dry or thin, attenu-
ating (Ved.); (अम्), n. the act of making dry or
thin; (in medicine) treatment for reducing fat or
corpulence.
—रूक्षणात्मिका (˚ण-आत्˚), f. a species
of grain (= लङ्का).

रूक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, made rough, rough; soiled,
smeared; [cf. अ-रूक्षित, रूषित.]
